1bb4e95dd2: Token-2022, WNS and Wen Open Lab: What Wen Built
fccb8785b2: Token-2022 is Solana's token program with extensions. WNS, the Wen New Standard, uses it to make NFTs light, open and fair to creators. Wen Open Lab turns both into free tools you can test: models, a till for shops and an AI skill.
538a56ba85: A token on Solana is a mint plus accounts. Token-2022 lets the mint carry extra rules — extensions — written into the token itself instead of into every app around it:
e0f81e53d2: Metadata — name, symbol and picture stored with the mint.
473eb72a8a: Transfer Hook — a program runs on every transfer; WNS uses it to enforce royalties.
858a7631ea: Non-Transferable — a soulbound token, used in the Lab's warranty receipts.
3012b423ce: Permanent Delegate — an issuer can move or burn tokens; powerful, so always check who holds it.
32d4f99989: Transfer Fee and Interest-Bearing — fees and yields defined at the token level.
cb97f6226e: Proposed on January 25, 2024, WNS describes NFTs as Token-2022 mints with metadata and group pointers, plus a transfer hook that enforces creator royalties. The code is open in the <a1>Wen Program Library</a1>. Read the almanac guides: <a2>Token-2022 and WNS</a2> and <a3>SPL, Token-2022 and WNS explained</a3>.
